_comment: Everything the outreach letters say about Clarity and the sender. Fill in every value marked TODO before approving anything: the pipeline page refuses to approve a letter while a TODO is still in here, so a placeholder can never reach a creator. These values are built into the pipeline page, so redeploy after editing (npm run app:deploy).
sender_title: TODO your title, e.g. Partnerships, ClarityTX
_offer_comment: One sentence, finished by the letter: 'Partners {{offer}}.' Example: 'earn 30% of every subscription that comes through their link, every month the clinician stays subscribed'.
_mailing_address_comment: CAN-SPAM requires a valid postal address in commercial email. It is added to the bottom of every email (not to TikTok DMs).
